svg.title: GitOps delivery with Argo CD
svg.desc: GitOps delivery with Argo CD. 16 components in 5 groups. Connections: Developer to Pull request (open PR); Pull request to GitHub Actions (merge); GitHub Actions to Container registry (push image); GitHub Actions to Config repository (bump image tag); Config repository to Argo CD (watch); Argo CD to Staging cluster (auto sync); Argo CD to Production cluster (manual sync); Ingress to Service; Service to Pods; Deployment to Pods; Ingress to Service; Service to Pods; Deployment to Pods; Grafana to Prometheus (query); Prometheus to Production cluster (scrape); Container registry to Staging cluster (pull image).

text.tspan: Actions pushes the image and bumps its tag; Argo CD syncs staging, then
